digest.component_or_area: CI workflows — tickets repository fetch and materialization
propositions: CI tickets-branch full fetches transfer excessive data (1.04–6.73 GiB) and should be optimized via blob:none partial clone to reduce pack transfer size and checkout duration.

actions/checkout steps in reconcile-bridge, verify-identity, and reconcile-bridge-canary workflows must include filter: blob:none while preserving fetch-depth: 0 and existing credential/ref configuration.

Gerrit direct-URL fetches in gerrit-verify.yaml must explicitly set --filter=blob:none on both require-ticket (depth-1) and verify-identity (full-history) fetch operations, with depth constraints preserved.

Production guardrails must parse and enforce post-materialization pack size limits (102400 KiB for standalone, 131072 KiB for Gerrit) and validate that git count-objects output is identical before and after identity scanning to prove no new promisor objects were fetched.

Real-Git protocol tests must confirm partial-clone capability advertisement and blob:none filter requests across named-remote inheritance and direct URLs, and verify the known large historical blob remains missing post-fetch.

E2E workflow must successfully materialize tickets, execute independent local/remote changes, perform merge-base operations with the ours driver, retain all expected events, and push the resulting merge without fetch regressions.
